name: 98951 · Wapato, WA
findings: ZIP 98951 (Wapato) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98951 (Wapato) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
